reviewer: Claude Code nightly (Opus): round 1 inspected all 23 sheets and fixed scenes 11, 17, 22; round 2 re-inspected the changed scenes

content.notes: Cover: you awake in bed at night, dark circles, the clock running, headline NACHT OHNE SCHLAF? matching line 0.

action.notes: Heavy blink, then a yawn while the clock hands sweep.

motion.notes: Bust sits on the pillow behind the blanket; the eyelids close and open gradually.

composition.notes: Large headline, face and clock clearly separated, subtitle on the blanket.

content.notes: The night is over; you still have to go to work.

action.notes: Sky and wall go from dark to bright, the clock reaches about 7, label ZUR ARBEIT?

motion.notes: Same bed, same character; the light change is continuous.

composition.notes: Window left, clock right, you lower right.

content.notes: 7 a.m. in the kitchen, drinking coffee (line 1).

action.notes: Hand reaches → grips the handle → lifts to the mouth → sips.

motion.notes: The hand reaches the handle before the mug leaves the table; the mug follows the hand and tilts toward the mouth.

composition.notes: Clock at 7:00 at the top, character centred.

content.notes: You feel awake enough: WACH bar.

action.notes: Lower the mug, smile, the bar fills, tick mark.

motion.notes: The mug stays in the hand while lowering; the face goes from tired to smiling.

composition.notes: Bar at the top, character in the middle.

timing.notes: Bar full and tick at 8.58 on 'wach'.

content.notes: The feeling says little about how reliably you can work (line 2).

action.notes: GEFÜHL bar full → dashed line + SAGT WENIG → ZUVERLÄSSIG? bar with stripes and '?'.

motion.notes: Bars and labels appear in order; no numbers made up.

composition.notes: Two bars stacked, head below, clear of the subtitle.

timing.notes: SAGT WENIG at 10.8 ('wenig'), second bar at 12.16 ('zuverlässig').

content.notes: Office: reading the e-mail several times.

action.notes: The highlight runs down the lines, jumps back to the first line, chip 2×.

motion.notes: Hands rest on the keyboard; eyes follow the line being read.

composition.notes: Screen left, you right.

content.notes: The overlooked instruction.

action.notes: The highlight goes line by line but skips line 5; that line turns red, label ANWEISUNG.

motion.notes: The highlight never stops on the red line.

composition.notes: Screen fills the frame, label at the top.

content.notes: Lack of sleep makes focusing harder (line 4).

action.notes: A focus beam from the eye points at the envelope, then drifts off.

motion.notes: The beam starts at the eye and wobbles smoothly.

composition.notes: Head in profile with the brain visible, envelope next to it.

timing.notes: Drifts off around 20.5–21.2, label KONZENTRATION at 20.98.

content.notes: Hard to retain new information.

action.notes: Three cards fly into the head, then slide out and fade.

motion.notes: Cards move along arcs, no teleporting.

composition.notes: Same head as scene 8, label BEHALTEN?

content.notes: A familiar task takes longer (line 5).

action.notes: Typing on the keyboard; the progress bar barely moves while the minute hand spins fast.

motion.notes: Hands tap the keyboard alternately; the bar fills only slowly.

composition.notes: Screen left, clock top right, you right.

content.notes: You keep having to check where you stopped.

action.notes: The pen hesitates, goes back to the top of the list twice, '?' appears, stops at row 4 and ticks it.

motion.notes: Fixed in round 2: the pen now sits in the hand (previously it pointed away from the hand); the pen moves with the hand.

composition.notes: Checklist large, hand comes in from the right.

content.notes: A colleague asks one more question (line 6).

action.notes: The colleague walks in from the right and talks, a '?' bubble pops up, you turn your eyes to her.

motion.notes: She slides in at shoulder height (bust), mouth moves while talking.

composition.notes: You left, colleague right; the monitor is partly cropped on the left.

content.notes: You react irritably.

action.notes: Brows furrow, you raise a hand to stop her, the mouth snaps, red jagged lines; the colleague looks startled.

motion.notes: The arm rises from the shoulder to the stop position; the colleague leans back slightly.

composition.notes: Close-up of the two, colleague on the right edge.

content.notes: Emotional control suffers (line 7).

action.notes: The dial wobbles in the teal zone, then swings into red and shakes; the face tightens.

motion.notes: The needle moves smoothly, then shakes and settles.

composition.notes: Large dial, head below, label at the top.

content.notes: A small thing turns into an argument.

action.notes: A small spark between the two grows into a big red burst, both frown and talk.

motion.notes: The spark grows steadily; both stay in place.

composition.notes: Two people on either side, spark in the middle.

content.notes: Drinking another coffee (line 8).

action.notes: The first mug stands empty; you reach for the second, lift it and sip.

motion.notes: Grip on the handle before lifting; the empty mug stays on the table.

composition.notes: Same office, character in the middle.

content.notes: Coffee reduces the feeling of tiredness (line 9).

action.notes: The MÜDIGKEIT bar drops from red to amber, the eyelids open more.

motion.notes: The bar shortens continuously. Round 2: removed the arrow under the mug that looked like a stick.

composition.notes: Bar at the top, head below.

content.notes: But it does not restore judgement the way sleep does.

action.notes: KAFFEE bar stops partway at a red line, SCHLAF bar fills and gets a tick; label URTEILSVERMÖGEN.

motion.notes: Bars fill in order, no percentages shown.

composition.notes: Two bars to compare, cup and moon icons.

content.notes: The way home at dusk (line 10).

action.notes: The car drives, lamp posts and trees slide past, the sky gets darker; label HEIMWEG.

motion.notes: Wheels turn in the direction of travel, the background moves left at a steady speed.

composition.notes: Car in the middle on the road, sun and sky behind.

content.notes: Microsleeps you do not notice.

action.notes: Seen through the windscreen: the eyelids drop twice, the head nods; label UNBEMERKT.

motion.notes: Hands stay on the steering wheel; the eyelids close and open gradually.

composition.notes: You in the centre, steering wheel below, dark car interior.

timing.notes: Closes at 52.2 and 53.6–54.7; label at 55.0 on 'bemerkst'.

content.notes: Eyes closed while the car keeps driving (line 11).

action.notes: Top half: eyes close completely; bottom half: the car keeps driving.

motion.notes: The eyelids lower continuously until closed; the car rolls steadily.

composition.notes: Split horizontally with a clear divider.

timing.notes: Fully closed at 57.5, car still driving at 58.88 ('weiterfährt').

content.notes: The 50 km/h example (line 12).

action.notes: The speedometer needle and number rise to 50, label 50 KM/H.

motion.notes: Round 2: the number now stops exactly at 50 (previously it jittered to 49).

composition.notes: Large speedometer on a dark background.

content.notes: 3 seconds = more than 40 m without watching (calculation 50/3.6×3≈41.7 m).

action.notes: 3 S chip → the car moves up the road, the stretch behind it goes dark with a closed-eye icon → bracket > 40 M → '?' in front.

motion.notes: The car moves continuously; the dark stretch grows with it.

composition.notes: Road vertical in the middle, 50 KM/H and 3 S chips at the top, bracket on the left.

timing.notes: 3 S at 62.73, > 40 M at 64.19 ('vierzig Meter'), '?' at 65.96 ('nicht verfolgst').

hook.notes: Frame 0 has the headline NACHT OHNE SCHLAF?, the tired face and the clock; the blink starts at 0.55 s and the scene changes at 2.2 s.

continuity.notes: Same character (brown hair, blue shirt, dark circles) throughout; same colleague in scenes 12–15; the coffee mug is the same colour in scenes 3, 4, 16 and 17; the car is red in scenes 19, 21 and 23.

pacing.notes: 23 shots / 68.8 s ≈ 3 s per shot; the long shots (5, 11, 23) carry continuous action; views alternate between scenes with the character and explanatory diagrams.
